m09_154.text:
Specialty Health Products Gain Momentum Under Streamlined Review Rules

Over the past eighteen months, national health agencies have accelerated the review of advanced medical products that closely match already-approved brand-name treatments. Unlike standard generic tablets, which can be made through simple chemical mixing, these specialized products are produced using complex natural processes, making exact copies impossible. Consequently, manufacturers must submit detailed lab test and safety comparison data to show that no meaningful differences exist between the new version and the original product.

Recent policy updates in both Europe and North America now waive redundant large-scale patient studies in select cases where safety and quality equivalence are clearly proven. Industry analysts predict that this policy shift could cut development timelines by up to two years and reduce launch costs by nearly 30 percent, ultimately expanding patient access to affordable long-term care treatments.

The maintenance crew no longer needs to inspect the seal.
The batch is within the approved nine-degree margin.

Examine product stability records together

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性題（名詞）。
• 解析：形容詞 widespread（廣泛的）後接不可數名詞 adoption（採用／普及）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 動詞；(A) 過去分詞／形容詞；(B) adoptive 意為「領養的／收養的」，語意不符。
• 單字補充：turnaround time（處理／檢測週轉時間）。

questions.q: ------- rigorously a medical device is tested in the lab, real-world user feedback remains essential for ongoing safety monitoring.
options: Whichever
Whenever
Whatever
However

explain.text:
• 考點：複合關係副詞（However + 副詞 + S + V）。
• 解析：空格後緊接副詞 rigorously（嚴格地），However rigorously ... 相當於 No matter how rigorously ...（無論測試得多嚴格）。
• 誘答分析：(C)(A) 後接名詞或直接接動詞；(B) 表時間「無論何時」。
• 單字補充：indispensable（不可或缺的）、post-market surveillance（上市後監測）。

questions.q: To ------- the risk of contamination, staff members must change protective coats whenever moving between lab areas.
options: proliferate
fabricate
mitigate
aggravate

explain.text:
• 考點：動詞字彙辨析。
• 解析：mitigate the risk 為高頻搭配，意為「減輕／降低風險」。
• 誘答分析：(D) 加劇、惡化；(A) 激增；(B) 捏造、製造。
• 單字補充：contamination（汙染）、protective coat（防護衣）。

questions.q: The healthcare group announced a ------- partnership with two university medical centers to support public health research.
options: strategize
strategically
strategic
strategy

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性題（形容詞）。
• 解析：空格修飾名詞 partnership，須填形容詞 strategic（策略性的）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 名詞；(B) 副詞；(A) 動詞。
• 單字補充：consortium（聯盟／財團）、rare-disease research（罕見疾病研究）。

questions.q: Employees participating in the wellness study were ------- assigned to either the morning exercise group or the evening group.
options: scarcely
mutually
randomly
formerly

explain.text:
• 考點：副詞字彙辨析。
• 解析：健康研究中，受試員工會被「隨機（randomly）」分配到晨間運動組或晚間運動組。
• 誘答分析：(A) 幾乎不；(B) 互相地；(D) 從前地。
• 單字補充：wellness study（健康研究）、randomly（隨機地）。

questions.q: Only after the independent safety monitoring board reviewed the interim data ------- permission to resume the product study.
options: did the agency grant
was granted the agency
the agency granted
had granted the agency

explain.text:
• 考點：否定／限定副詞片語置於句首的倒裝句（Only after ... + 助動詞 + S + V）。
• 解析：Only after + 時間副詞子句 置於句首時，主要子句須採疑問句語序倒裝，故選 did the agency grant。
• 誘答分析：(C) 未倒裝；(B)(D) 主被動與語序錯誤。
• 單字補充：interim data（期中數據）、dosing（給藥）。

questions.q: The updated health insurance policy covers preventive screenings, ------- annual physicals, vision checks, and blood tests, at no out-of-pocket cost.
options: such as
provided that
in addition
as well

explain.text:
• 考點：舉例片語。
• 解析：後方列舉三項預防性篩檢項目（mammograms, colonoscopies, and lipid panels），故選 such as（例如）。
• 誘答分析：(D) as well 須加 as 才能接名詞；(C) in addition 須加 to；(B) provided that 為「倘若」。
• 單字補充：mammogram（乳房攝影）、colonoscopy（大腸鏡）、lipid panel（血脂檢測）。

questions.q: Because the patent on the popular blood-pressure product is set to ------- next quarter, competing manufacturers are preparing their market launches.
options: transpire
inspire
aspire
expire

explain.text:
• 考點：動詞字彙辨析。
• 解析：藥品專利「到期（expire）」，學名藥廠便準備上市。
• 誘答分析：(B) 啟發；(A) 發生、洩漏；(C) 渴望。
• 單字補充：antihypertensive（降血壓的）、generic manufacturer（學名藥廠）。

questions.q: The wellness committee's proposal to install standing desks throughout the headquarters was ------- endorsed by the executive leadership team.
options: unanimously
unanimous
unanime
unanimity

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性題（副詞修飾動詞）。
• 解析：空格位於助動詞 was 與過去分詞 endorsed 之間，須填副詞 unanimously（一致地）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 名詞；(B) 形容詞；(C) 拼字錯誤。
• 單字補充：endorse（背書／支持通過）、standing desk（站立式辦公桌）。

questions.q: ------- who experience persistent eye strain should schedule an occupational optometry consultation through the employee assistance portal.
options: Anyone
Someone
Whoever
Those

explain.text:
• 考點：代名詞與關係子句主詞一致性。
• 解析：關係子句動詞為複數 experience，故先行詞須為複數代名詞 Those（Those who ... 意為「凡是……的人」）。
• 誘答分析：(A)(B)(C) 皆須搭配單數動詞 experiences。
• 單字補充：eye strain（眼睛疲勞）、optometry（視光學／驗光）。

questions.q: The compliance specialist compiled a ------- report containing over four hundred pages of safety, quality, and performance studies.
options: comprehensive
comprehensible
respective
apprehensive

explain.text:
• 考點：形容詞字彙辨析（易混淆字）。
• 解析：超過四百頁包含穩定性、毒性與生體相等性研究的檔案，應為「全面詳盡的（comprehensive）」。
• 誘答分析：(B) 可理解的；(D) 憂慮的；(C) 各自的。
• 單字補充：dossier（送審檔案）、bioequivalence（生體相等性）。

questions.q: Under the revised occupational health guidelines, laboratory staff must undergo audiometric testing ------- a year to monitor noise exposure.
options: single
one
first
once

explain.text:
• 考點：頻率副詞搭配。
• 解析：once a year 為固定搭配，意為「一年一次」。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(A) 均無法構成「一年一次」的頻率表達。
• 單字補充：audiometric testing（聽力檢測）、noise exposure（噪音暴露）。

questions.q: ------- the mixing tank reaches the target temperature of 25 degrees, the automated valve will release the cooling solution into the container.
options: Lest
Once
Whereas
Unless

explain.text:
• 考點：時間從屬連接詞。
• 解析：Once（一旦）發酵槽達到目標酸鹼值 pH 7.2，自動閥就會釋放營養緩衝液，符合製程邏輯。
• 誘答分析：(D) 除非；(C) 然而；(A) 以免（後常接原形動詞或 should）。
• 單字補充：mixing tank（混合槽）、cooling solution（冷卻液）。

questions.q: The hospital network's investment in telehealth infrastructure has ------- improved specialist access for patients in remote mountainous areas.
options: substantiate
substantially
substance
substantial

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性題（副詞修飾動詞）。
• 解析：空格位於 has 與過去分詞 improved 之間，須用副詞 substantially（大幅地）修飾。
• 誘答分析：(D) 形容詞；(C) 名詞；(A) 動詞。
• 單字補充：telehealth infrastructure（遠距醫療基礎設施）。

questions.q: All medical waste containers must be sealed and labeled ------- to the standards outlined in Section 4 of the Workplace Safety Manual.
options: compliant
according
consistent
regardless

explain.text:
• 考點：介系詞搭配（according to）。
• 解析：空格後接 to，according to 意為「依據、按照」。
• 誘答分析：(D) regardless 要接 of，語意也不合；(C) consistent 搭配 with；(A) compliant 搭配 with。
• 單字補充：medical waste（醫療廢棄物）。

questions.q: Dr. Patel's research team ------- the patient survey data for three months before identifying the key factor linked to recovery speed.
options: had been analyzing
has been analyzing
is analyzing
will analyze

explain.text:
• 考點：過去完成進行式（had been + V-ing）。
• 解析：句尾有過去時間點 before identifying ...（在找出關鍵因素之前），強調在該過去動作前已持續進行三個月的動作，故用過去完成進行式 had been analyzing。
• 誘答分析：(B) 現在完成進行式（與過去動作時間軸不符）；(D) 未來式；(C) 現在進行式。
• 單字補充：patient survey data（病患調查數據）、recovery speed（復原速度）。

questions.q: The company's mental health helpline provides ------- counseling sessions, ensuring that no personal details are shared with supervisors.
options: conspicuous
confident
confidential
contagious

explain.text:
• 考點：形容詞字彙辨析（易混淆字）。
• 解析：由後半句「確保個人細節不會與主管分享」可知，心理健康專線提供的是「保密的（confidential）」諮商。
• 誘答分析：(B) 有自信的；(A) 顯眼的；(D) 具傳染性的。
• 單字補充：helpline（諮詢專線）、counseling session（諮商療程）。

questions.q: ------- of the two proposed packaging designs demonstrated superior heat resistance during the ninety-day durability test.
options: All
Every
Neither
Several

explain.text:
• 考點：代名詞辨析（兩者皆不）。
• 解析：後方明確指出 the two proposed packaging designs（兩種包裝設計），兩者皆否定用 Neither，接單數動詞；Every 不能直接接 of the，All 與 Several 用於三者以上，故選 Neither。
• 誘答分析：(B) Every 不可接 of；(A)(D) 用於三者以上。
• 單字補充：durability test（耐用度測試）、heat resistance（耐熱性）。

questions.q: Manufacturing supervisors must verify that every air filter has passed a quality test ------- packaging the final medical product.
options: owing to
prior to
instead
in order

explain.text:
• 考點：時間介系詞片語。
• 解析：空格後接動名詞 packaging，prior to（在……之前）為介系詞片語，符合語法與「包裝前先確認濾心通過品質測試」的醫療產品流程。
• 誘答分析：(D) in order 後接 to V；(C) instead 須加 of；(A) owing to 表原因「由於」。
• 單字補充：integrity test（完整性測試）、injectable（注射劑）。

questions.q: The startup's breakthrough in smart health monitoring systems attracted ------- from three international medical companies.
options: investments
investing
invest
invested

explain.text:
• 考點：名詞字彙與語意搭配。
• 解析：動詞 attracted（吸引）受詞為「投資資金（investments）」，即「吸引了來自三家國際醫療公司的投資」。
• 誘答分析：(D) invested 為動詞變化，不能當 attracted 的受詞；(B)(C) 詞性不符。
• 單字補充：breakthrough（突破）、health monitoring（健康監測）。

questions.q: ------- its compact footprint, the portable ultrasound unit delivers high-resolution imaging comparable to full-sized hospital consoles.
options: Except
Although
Even
Despite

explain.text:
• 考點：讓步介系詞 vs. 連接詞。
• 解析：空格後為名詞片語 its compact footprint，須選介系詞 Despite（儘管）。
• 誘答分析：(B) Although 須接完整子句；(C) Even 不能單獨接名詞；(A) Except 語意不符。
• 單字補充：compact footprint（精巧的機身佔地面積）、portable ultrasound（可攜式超音波）。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (131).
options: Otherwise
However
Furthermore
Nevertheless

explain.text: 考點：轉折／遞進副詞。前句說補助金從 400 調高到 650 美元，後句進一步補充資金適用範圍擴大，故選 Furthermore（此外）。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (132).
options: In addition, we are introducing a dedicated mental health leave policy.
Unfortunately, dental coverage premiums will rise slightly in the spring.
Consequently, the cafeteria will discontinue sugary beverages next month.
Meanwhile, the annual flu vaccination drive has been postponed until November.

explain.text: 考點：句子插入題。空格後緊接著說明全職員工每年將獲得四天帶薪「充電假」，無需醫療證明，故前句應引入「心理健康假政策」，選 (A)。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (133).
options: proactivity
proactively speaking
reactive
proactively

explain.text: 考點：詞性題（副詞）。修飾動詞 use this time，須用副詞 proactively（主動提前地），與後面 before burnout occurs 呼應。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (134).
options: directed
inspected
complied
prescribed

explain.text:
考點：動詞搭配。direct questions to ... 意為「將問題轉交／詢問……」，採被動式 be directed to。
• 單字補充：registered dietitian（註冊營養師）、burnout（職業倦怠）。

Passage 2（Q135–138：藥品仿單修訂法規通知）

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (135).
options: concealed
amended
abolished
imitated

explain.text: 考點：動詞字彙辨析。仿單第五節「警語與注意事項」經過「修訂（amended）」以納入腎功能監測指引。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (136).
options: The effectiveness of Cardiovex® in younger adults remains unchanged.
Therefore, all manufacturing lines will halt production for two weeks.
No product size or main ingredient has been altered in this update.
Patients are advised to discontinue the medication immediately.

explain.text: 考點：句子插入題。前段講述仿單文字更新，後段說明舊包裝庫存仍可附上補充貼紙繼續配發至 12 月 31 日；(C)「此次更新未改變劑量規格或有效成分」最能銜接為何舊庫存仍可使用。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (137).
options: Within
Until
Prior
As of

explain.text: 考點：時間介系詞。As of January 1 意為「自 1 月 1 日起」，搭配後句「任何過期仿單庫存必須隔離退回」。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (138).
options: certified
certify
certification
certifying

explain.text:
考點：複合名詞。certification forms 意為「認證／合規證明表單」，符合簽署並上傳法規檔案庫的語境。
• 單字補充：package insert（產品說明書）、safety monitoring（安全監測）、reverse-logistics（逆向物流／退貨回收）。

Passage 3（Q139–142：睡眠恢復裝置研究新聞稿）

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (139).
options: In contrast
Even so
Instead
Moreover

explain.text: 考點：遞進連接副詞。前句講睡眠品質改善率高（68% vs. 24%），後句補充晨間疲勞分數也顯著下降，故選 Moreover（此外）。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (140).
options: The company's stock price fell slightly following the quarterly earnings call.
A wearable device could offer greater convenience and improved long-term daily use.
Researchers have not yet determined how the battery performs in cold weather.
Enrollment for the night-shift group was suspended due to budget constraints.

explain.text: 考點：句子插入題。首席健康官前一句提到「對傳統助眠方法反應不佳的員工是重大里程碑」，(B)「穿戴式裝置能提供更高便利性與長期日常使用率」直接承接穿戴式裝置的優勢。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (141).
options: elevators
elevations
elevating
elevated

explain.text: 考點：名詞複合語。blood pressure elevations 意為「血壓升高」，與前面 No serious skin reactions 並列作主詞。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (142).
options: scheduled
scheduling
schedule
to schedule

explain.text:
考點：with + O + OC（分詞結構）。with a broader commercial launch scheduled to begin ...，商業上市是「被排定」展開，故用過去分詞 scheduled。
• 單字補充：control group（對照組）、fatigue score（疲勞分數）、commercial launch（商業上市）。

Passage 4（Q143–146：實驗區 HVAC 檢查進度電子郵件）

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (143).
options: consistency
consist
consistently
consistent

explain.text: 考點：詞性題（副詞）。修飾連綴動詞後的介系詞片語（或形容詞概念），表達「持續穩定地維持在 15 至 20 帕斯卡範圍內」，用副詞 consistently。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (144).
options: Therefore
However
Likewise
Accordingly

explain.text: 考點：轉折副詞。前句說 HEPA 濾網與壓差全數合格，後句提到夜間交班時濕度短暫飆升超過警戒值，語意轉折，選 However。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (145).
options: The vendor has already dispatched a technician to replace the faulty component.
Several operators reported that the entry hallway felt unusually warm.
The annual fire drill is scheduled to take place next Tuesday at 10:00 A.M.
As a result, Room 3B will be permanently converted into a dry-goods warehouse.

explain.text: 考點：句子插入題。前句說承包商查出原因為 2 號回風管風門致動器延遲，後句說「一旦替換零件明早校準完成」，(A)「廠商已派技術員前來更換故障零件」完美銜接兩句。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (146).
options: I am
I had
I will have
I would

explain.text:
考點：客氣請求句型。I would appreciate your guidance on ... 為商務書信標準客氣用法，選 (D)。
• 單字補充：operational qualification (OQ)（操作確效）、differential pressure（壓差）、actuator（致動器）。

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the notice?
options: To report missing lot numbers in paper logbooks
To schedule a mandatory audit of BioTrace ELN v4.5
To require staff to submit legacy logbooks on November 18
To announce a shift to digital laboratory documentation

explain.text: 考點：主旨題（同義替換）。公告淘汰紙本紀錄本改用雲端 BioTrace ELN v4.5，對應 (D) shift to digital laboratory documentation；(B)(A)(C) 挪用 audit、lot numbers、November 18 誘答。

questions.q: What are staff members instructed to bring to the workshop?
options: A printed copy of the updated audit standards
A secured portable computer
Two-factor authentication tokens from Quality Systems
Their legacy paper laboratory logbooks

explain.text:
考點：細節題（上位概念替換）。指示攜帶 encrypted company laptop，對應 (B) secured portable computer。

Q149–150（穩定性試驗箱異常簡訊對話）

questions.q: Why does Priya Nair tell Marcus Chen to wait ten minutes?
options: Chamber 4 is still undergoing a 10:00 A.M. humidity check.
The children's syrup trays are not on the middle rack.
Marcus Chen has not checked the stability chamber logs yet.
She must document the irregularity in the QA system first.

explain.text: 考點：原因細節（同義替換）。Priya 說要先開立偏差紀錄單（log a deviation ticket first so our QA documentation stays intact），對應 (D) document the irregularity in the QA system first。

questions.q: What will Marcus Chen probably do next?
options: Adjust the drifting humidity sensor in the original unit
Meet Priya Nair at 10:00 A.M. to inspect Lot #884
Relocate the syrup trays before logging a deviation ticket
Get the alternative chamber ready for the transfer

explain.text:
考點：推論下一步（同義替換）。Marcus 回覆 I'll prep the backup chamber，對應 (D) Get the alternative chamber ready。

Q151–153（PosturePro 升降工作站廣告）

questions.q: What feature of the PosturePro™ workstation is specifically highlighted for hygiene?
options: A programmable LED reminder panel
A whisper-quiet dual-motor lift system
A 120 kg hospital-grade steel frame
Materials designed to inhibit bacterial growth

explain.text: 考點：細節題（同義替換）。antimicrobial laminate surfaces（抗菌層壓表面）同義替換為 (D) Materials designed to inhibit bacterial growth。

questions.q: What is NOT included in the special offer for orders of 25 or more units?
options: A complimentary LED reminder panel
A ten-year extended motor warranty
A 15% volume price reduction
Complimentary on-site calibration by a specialist

explain.text: 考點：NOT 題。特惠包含 15% 折扣 (C)、免費到場校準 (D)、10 年馬達保固 (B)；LED 提醒面板為標準配備而非滿額贈品，故選 (A)。

questions.q: How can a company obtain a customized floor-plan assessment?
options: By placing an order for at least 25 units before November 30
By visiting a healthcare administrative office
By sending an electronic message to the sales team
By calling a certified physical therapist directly

explain.text:
考點：行動方式（同義替換）。寫信至 sales@posturepro-ergo.com 對應 (C) sending an electronic message to the sales team。

Q154–156（專業醫療產品法規簡化文章）

questions.q: Why are these specialized products harder to copy than standard generic tablets?
options: They require chemical mixing that takes eighteen months.
Manufacturers refuse to submit detailed safety comparison data.
Health agencies in Europe prohibit exact copies.
Their biological production methods cannot be precisely replicated.

explain.text: 考點：細節題（同義替換）。produced using complex natural processes, making exact copies impossible 替換為 (D) biological production methods cannot be precisely replicated。
